_docs: Per-install background services (launchd on macOS). Read by LIFEOS/TOOLS/Services.ts loadUserServices(): the file must be a JSON array; entries without a string `label` AND a string `install` are ignored (this docs entry is ignored that way). DeployComponents.ts records declined core service labels in this entry's `_declined` array. InstallAgentJobs.ts appends one entry per enabled job in agent-jobs.json with category `jobs`. Shipped system services live in Services.ts itself; only YOUR private machinery goes here.

_entry_shape.label: com.lifeos.example (the launchd label; `com.lifeos.<x>` for services you install, a vendor label for a mounted sidecar)
_entry_shape.title: Human title shown in Pulse and `Services.ts status`
_entry_shape.purpose: One line on what it does
_entry_shape.category: one of: pulse | sidecar | capture | sync | sweep | maintenance | jobs
_entry_shape.optIn: boolean — true for opt-in extras, false for default-on core
_entry_shape.install: shell command that installs and loads it; a `#`-prefixed string is a note, not runnable
_entry_shape.uninstall: optional shell command that unloads and removes it
